one_liner_zh: Adobe第四季營收年增12.69%且EPS微幅優於預期，顯示核心業務需求穩健。
one_liner_en: Adobe reported Q4 revenue up 12.69% YoY with EPS slightly beating expectations, reflecting steady core demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS實際6.13美元高於預估的6.09美元
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘(EPS)為6.13美元，優於市場預期的6.09美元
核心數位媒體與數位體驗業務維持穩健的成長動能
本益比處於14.06倍的相對合理水準
highlights_en: Revenue reached $6.62 billion, representing a 12.69% YoY increase.
EPS came in at $6.13, beating the consensus estimate of $6.09.
Core Digital Media and Digital Experience segments maintained steady growth momentum.
Trailing P/E ratio stands at a reasonable 14.06.
risks_zh: 生成式AI工具領域的競爭日益激烈，可能對定價能力構成壓力
宏觀經濟不確定性可能導致企業客戶延遲IT與行銷軟體預算
risks_en: Increasing competition in generative AI tools could pressure pricing power.
Macroeconomic uncertainty may lead enterprise customers to delay IT and marketing software budgets.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本次財報表現穩健，營收與獲利雙雙小幅優於預期，顯示其軟體訂閱模式具備防禦性。對股價短中期而言，評價面具備吸引力，但能否進一步上攻取決於AI貨幣化進程與新產品滲透率。追蹤指標應關注剩餘履約價值(RPO)增長與AI功能付費轉換率。
ai_view_en: view: Solid results with a slight beat on both top and bottom lines demonstrate the defensive nature of the subscription model. For the near to mid-term, the valuation is attractive, but further upside depends on AI monetization progress and new product adoption rates. Key metrics to track include remaining performance obligations (RPO) growth and AI feature conversion rates.
